I was just dropped off by an Uber in front of my cousin's house. I never really talked to him but, my dad said he is wonderful so, I'll go into this with an open mind and focus on my schooling as I live with him through the school year.*

*My little brown sandals hit daintily against the concrete as I approach his front door. I give a light huff trying to gather my thoughts ready to live with my cousin. Although, I'm anxious, I'm excited to start my new life.*

*I knock gently on his door with my small hand and place my hands behind my back arching my chest forward innocently. I try to run through many ways to greet my uncle as I shake lightly causing my little white summer dress to crinkle.*
